    g = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Locate full-width and full-height divider lines.
    d = next(v for v in range(1, 10)
             if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
             and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h))

    rb = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + vc + [w]
    bands = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    tiles = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]

    # Reflect each horizontal band pattern into its neighbor, leaving
    # existing colored cells intact.

        a, b = bands[i]
        c, e = bands[i + 1]
        for x, y in tiles:

    return g

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Full rows/columns of the frame color divide the canvas into tiles.
    divider = next(v for v in range(1, 10)
                   if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
                   and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h))
                           for c in range(w)))
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == divider for x in grid[r])]
    rb = [-1] + hr + [h]
    bands = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]

    # Each divider between bands is an axis of reflection. Reflect motifs
    # from either side into the corresponding positions on the other side.
    for i in range(len(bands) - 1):
        a, b = bands[i]
        c, e = bands[i + 1]
        depth = min(b - a, e - c)
        for k in range(depth):
            for col in range(w):
                upper_r = b - 1 - k
                lower_r = c + k
                v = grid[upper_r][col]
                if v not in (0, divider) and out[lower_r][col] == 0:
                    out[lower_r][col] = v
                v = grid[lower_r][col]
                if v not in (0, divider) and out[upper_r][col] == 0:
                    out[upper_r][col] = v
    return out
